en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The Prophetsaww said: ‘The first one to variegate the goods was Ibrahimas, and the first one to soften Al-Sareyd was Hashimas’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Nawfaliy from al-Sakuniy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Holy Prophet has said, ‘
The first one who made food of several kinds was Ibrahim, and the first who made Tharid was Hashim.’”
